about: Floors for the CI throughput smoke (benchmarks/throughput_smoke.py, ci.yml job throughput-smoke,
report-only: not in the Required PR gate until it has 5 consecutive green runs).

The PR job runs pg-pg-pr (PG->PG binary COPY incl. the jsonb carry, 20k rows, load method checked), pg-pg-row and pg-mysql; the dispatch workflow's check_floors step checks every other floor (pg-pg, mysql-pg) on the full matrix.
Each entry runs benchmarks/db_throughput.py and fails below min_rows_per_second. rows/s is over
the whole engine call, Gate-8 included; at or below 250k rows the in-memory verification ladder
runs too, so it is lower than a 1M run on the same route.
Floors are set against a machine whose calibrate() takes reference_calibration_seconds (the
local 4-vCPU box, 2026-11-21: 0.39 s). On a slower runner the smoke scales a floor down by
reference / measured, never up and never below MIN_SCALE (0.75) of it: two hosted-runner jobs on
The code before the per-column fast paths ran 236-271 rows/s on the row path locally (100k rows,
70cb4669c). Every row-path floor at 0.75 scale stays above 290 rows/s, so losing the fast paths
trips the gate on any runner. Local clean rates after: pg-pg row path 524, pg-mysql (MariaDB) 446
(MySQL 8 in CI: 469-953), mysql-pg 550, pg-pg copy 1768. Raise a floor only with CI artifacts.
